sloka: कच्चित्सुखं नदीतीरे ऽवात्सी: काकुत्स्थ शर्वरीम् ।कच्चित्ते सहसैन्यस्य तावत्सर्वमनामयम् ।। २.८९.५ ।।
transliteration: kaccitsukhaṁ nadītīre 'vātsī: kākutstha śarvarīm ।kaccitte sahasainyasya tāvatsarvamanāmayam ।। 2.89.5 ।।

translations.english: O scion of the Kakutstha race (Bharata) I trust, you and your army passed the night on the river bank comfortably without any inconvenience.
